
Principal author of the [[lessons|lessons]].  See [http://neptune.spaceports.com/~words/lojban.html].

Synonyms: Robin the Turk, Robin.TR:

* he is not an ethnic Turk
* he is English

* he lives in [[jbocre: Turkey|Turkey]]
* his mailing address ends in .tr

* Suffixing him with .tr helps distinguish him from [[jbocre: Robin Lee Powell|Robin Lee Powell]]
** Who is sometimes called Robin.CA, because he is originally Canadian and lives in California.
